content.short: ALLIN is a community driven betting ecosystem where the token holders earn profits and participate in governance.
content.description: ALLIN is a community driven decentralized betting ecosystem where the token holders earn profits and have a say in governance. Existing betting apps are centralized and designed to exploit players. ALLIN will have the best atmosphere and most wagering options but in a way that is more fair and gives the profits and governance to the token holders. By engaging the community, we can create a realistic plan to assist bettors with addiction issues and encourage a more knowledgeable and friendly environment.
